revs: Just wanted to say a massive thank you to you & the team for the amazing cocktails at the wedding, you guys absolutely smashed it! Everyone really enjoyed them. Thanks for all your help, service was 💯👌🏽 Thank you again & look forward to using you again in the future❤️🫶🏼🍸

From our very first conversation, Vooshka understood exactly what we envisioned for our wedding and made it happen! The management team were so kind, respectful and polite, and nothing was ever too much trouble. The cocktails and mocktails tasted absolutely amazing, and so many of our guests commented on how good they were! The mixologists and bartenders were fantastic, so friendly and engaging with all our guests. The whole team really went above and beyond to make our day special. Couldn’t recommend Vooshka enough!

We can’t recommend Vooshka enough! They absolutely smashed it at our wedding, from the initial planning right through to the day itself.  Raj and his team really listened to what we wanted and helped bring our vision to life. They also shared some great ideas to make the experience even better for our guests, from designing the menu and setting up the bar to creating a fantastic cocktail experience.  We had a tasting session with our family, which was a great touch, and even came up with some fun, quirky cocktail names to fit our wedding theme.  The cocktail bar was a massive hit with our guests and really added something special to the day. Raj and the team also had a few surprises up their sleeves, which helped take the party to another level!  The whole team were brilliant from start to finish, and their attention to detail and willingness to go the extra mile really made a difference.  A massive thank you to Raj and everyone at Vooshka for helping make our wedding so special. If you’re planning a wedding or event and want something a bit different, we’d 100% recommend them!

Amazing Cocktails and Fantastic Service!  The cocktails at our wedding were amazing, and all our guests raved about them! The tasting beforehand was a fantastic addition, allowing me to create cocktails that perfectly suited our wedding. The service was great, and the attention to detail was brilliant, with the cocktail board and menus designed to match our wedding theme. Everything felt personal and was done to such a high standard. The cocktails were a real highlight of our day, and I couldn’t recommend them enough to anyone looking for something special for their wedding or event. Thank you for making our day extra special!
